## Decisions

- `kb:adr/actions-mainhead-one-stop-resume-button` — The Focus header has one Stop/Resume button, labelled by whether the session is alive, the same box under both labels; tile footers keep separate buttons. (accepted, 2026-10-13; features: actions, focus) → `docs/adr/actions-mainhead-one-stop-resume-button.md`
- `kb:adr/actions-pane-snapshot-display-only` — The daemon captures each live pane on every liveness tick and serves the last capture for a dead session, dimmed under an ended cap; display only. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: actions, focus) → `docs/adr/actions-pane-snapshot-display-only.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-added-dirs-folder-suffix-and-location-panel` — The Focus header folder line ends in a muted +N while directories are added; a mouse-hover panel lists the location and the added directories. (accepted, 2026-10-19; features: focus) → `docs/adr/focus-added-dirs-folder-suffix-and-location-panel.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-effort-dismiss-404-uses-shared-body` — The effort-warning dismiss route's 404 is the shared unknown_session body, "unknown session id", through the shared id parse and writer. (accepted, 2026-10-15; features: focus) → `docs/adr/focus-effort-dismiss-404-uses-shared-body.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-effort-mismatch-warning-persisted-per-session` — A launch whose first status report contradicts its chosen effort gets a warning stored on the session row, shown under the Focus header until dismissed. (accepted, 2026-10-15; features: focus, launch, card-location) → `docs/adr/focus-effort-mismatch-warning-persisted-per-session.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-group-control-hides-below-640px-container-width` — The Focus header's group control hides by a container query at 640px of the header's own width; the title floor stays 6rem, not the mockup's 22ch. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: focus, rail) → `docs/adr/focus-group-control-hides-below-640px-container-width.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-header-give-way-order-title-last` — The Focus header gives way in order — ↳ block hides, switch and actions drop to row two, readout ellipsizes to its floor, title shortens last. (accepted, 2026-10-13; features: focus) → `docs/adr/focus-header-give-way-order-title-last.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-header-readout-sized-by-text` — The Focus header's repo readout wraps at the slash with each line as wide as its text, no character cap; rail card and tile header keep their shapes. (accepted, 2026-10-13; features: focus, rail, tiles) → `docs/adr/focus-header-readout-sized-by-text.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-location-panel-lists-every-row` — The location panel lists every added directory uncapped; past what fits below the readout it flips to the top, and rows past the viewport drop off. (accepted, 2026-10-19; features: focus) → `docs/adr/focus-location-panel-lists-every-row.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-model-never-truncates-name-blocks-give-way` — In the Focus header the model never truncates at any width; the ↳ block gives way first and the header wraps before the repo block would. (accepted, 2026-10-01; features: focus) → `docs/adr/focus-model-never-truncates-name-blocks-give-way.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-rail-click-focuses-terminal` — A pointer click on a rail card puts keyboard focus in that session's terminal; keyboard activation, number chords and the Tiles strip only select. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: focus, rail, surfaces) → `docs/adr/focus-rail-click-focuses-terminal.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-rail-plus-one-live-pane` — The Focus view is a rail of static cards beside exactly one live pane, with account usage in a persistent masthead. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: focus, rail, usage) → `docs/adr/focus-rail-plus-one-live-pane.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-surface-switch-pinned-with-actions` — The Focus header's surface switch sits with the actions in one right-aligned cluster, placed by the header's width alone; the model moves with the readout. (accepted, 2026-10-13; features: focus, surfaces) → `docs/adr/focus-surface-switch-pinned-with-actions.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-bypass-offered-with-danger-guardrails` — Start in offers bypass as a danger segment with a warning line and a danger Launch without checks button; a bypass chip marks the session wherever it shows. (accepted, 2026-09-28; features: launch, rail, focus, tiles) → `docs/adr/launch-bypass-offered-with-danger-guardrails.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-opens-launched-session` — A successful launch opens the launched session: Focus focuses it, and both views move keyboard focus into its terminal. (accepted, 2026-09-23; features: launch, focus, tiles) → `docs/adr/launch-opens-launched-session.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-resume-null-model-reads-unknown` — A session resumed from the list with no recorded model shows "unknown" as its model rather than omitting the model clause. (accepted, 2026-09-28; features: launch, focus) → `docs/adr/launch-resume-null-model-reads-unknown.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-card-shows-launch-directory-marks-claude-elsewhere` — The card, shell, docs reader and file drop stay on the launch directory; a secondary ↳ readout shows where Claude is only while in another checkout. (accepted, 2026-10-01; features: lifecycle, rail, focus, tiles, card-location) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-card-shows-launch-directory-marks-claude-elsewhere.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-current-marker-means-shown-in-focus` — The rail marks the session the Focus pane shows with a neutral treatment and aria-current; it never means live in this view, so Tiles renders none. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: rail, focus) → `docs/adr/rail-current-marker-means-shown-in-focus.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-launch-leaves-rail-scroll-untouched` — A launch leaves the rail's scroll alone, as the number chords do, so the current marker may sit on an off-screen card in an overflowing rail. (accepted, 2026-09-23; features: launch, rail, focus) → `docs/adr/rail-launch-leaves-rail-scroll-untouched.md`
- `kb:adr/rename-muster-owned-title-override-wins` — A post-launch rename is a Muster-owned nullable title override that wins over the status-line name; the wire title is the display title. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: rename, tiles, focus) → `docs/adr/rename-muster-owned-title-override-wins.md`
- `kb:adr/session-effort-tri-state-from-status-line` — A session's effort is read from every status post and carried on the wire as not-yet-reported, a level, or reported-with-no-effort. (accepted, 2026-10-15; features: card-location, focus) → `docs/adr/session-effort-tri-state-from-status-line.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-warn-tokens-not-amber` — Warnings use a --warn token family, a yellow outside amber's band in every theme; amber stays Needs-Input and the banner/danger tokens keep their roles. (accepted, 2026-10-15; features: focus) → `docs/adr/theme-warn-tokens-not-amber.md`
- `kb:adr/views-focus-and-tiles-peers` — The dashboard has two peer views, Focus and Tiles, switched from the masthead or a chord, with the choice persisted daemon-side. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: views, focus, tiles) → `docs/adr/views-focus-and-tiles-peers.md`
- `kb:adr/web-menu-component-single-builder` — One menu builder serves every dashboard menu — rail ⋯, header ⋯, Move to and the Focus-header control — and the design system gains a Menu component. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, focus, actions, groups) → `docs/adr/web-menu-component-single-builder.md`

## Lessons

- `kb:lesson/layout-invariant-needs-its-width-range` — A "never truncates" rule tested at one width took four review cycles: each fix was checked at the widths named, and the next sweep found the next case. (active, 2026-10-01; features: focus) → `docs/lessons/layout-invariant-needs-its-width-range.md`

## Retired, rejected and superseded

- `kb:adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows` — End, Resume and Remove live in a mainhead above the focused terminal and in hover-revealed action rows on rail cards and tile footers, behind confirm dialogs. (superseded, 2026-08-27; features: actions, focus, rail, tiles) → `docs/adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-group-control-stays-while-title-shortens` — Above the 640 px breakpoint the Focus header's group control stays while a long title shortens beside it; the title gives way first, the control goes whole. (superseded, 2026-10-05; features: focus) → `docs/adr/focus-group-control-stays-while-title-shortens.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-mainhead-title-keeps-a-floor` — The mainhead title shrinks first and ellipsises but never below 6rem, so Focus keeps a visible, clickable rename trigger; a short title leaves a small gap. (superseded, 2026-09-29; features: focus) → `docs/adr/focus-mainhead-title-keeps-a-floor.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-mainhead-wraps-to-second-row-when-narrow` — The Focus mainhead wraps to a second row as soon as the repo block would drop below its floor, so the model, actions and repo readout all stay whole. (superseded, 2026-10-01; features: focus) → `docs/adr/focus-mainhead-wraps-to-second-row-when-narrow.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-repo-block-keeps-floor-beside-group-control` — Beside the group control the Focus header's repo block keeps its 8-character floor and never hides; the title gives way first, so a long folder may ellipsize. (superseded, 2026-10-05; features: focus, rail) → `docs/adr/focus-repo-block-keeps-floor-beside-group-control.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-repo-line-wraps-at-slash` — The repo readout wraps at the slash, folder over branch, each line truncated with a hover; compact and tile headers stay one line; the model never truncates. (superseded, 2026-10-01; features: rail, focus, tiles) → `docs/adr/rail-repo-line-wraps-at-slash.md`
